176-4875-5686.easyPrerequisites:
Conspiracy has any type chosen that isn't "Spirit".
You control another creature.
176-4875-5686.description:
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Requiem Angel triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token. The token won't be a Soldier due to Conspiracy.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability, creating a Blood token.
Repeat.

3234-3293-5412-6495.easyPrerequisites: You control a Plains or have a Plains in your graveyard.
3234-3293-5412-6495.description:
Activate Coastal Hornclaw by sacrificing a land.
Repeat step 1 until you control no lands.
Activate Evereth by sacrificing World Shaper.
When World Shaper dies, it triggers, return all lands from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the lands enter, Emeria Shepherd triggers that many times.
Resolve an Emeria Shepherd trigger that was triggered by a Plains, returning World Shaper from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve all remaining Emeria Shepherd triggers.
Resolve the Evereth ability.
Repeat
3234-3293-5412-6495.notes:
You can return all nonland permanents in your graveyard and library to the battlefield if you control there are two or more Plains between your graveyard, library and battlefield. To do this, have all triggers from Emeria Shepherd target desired permanents. Then, resolve the Plains triggers first to return those cards to the battlefield, causing all other triggers to fizzle on the stack.
If you have a way to kill Evereth and {1}{B/R} available, you can do so after putting a significant amount of +1/+1 counters on it to deal damage to each opponent using its second ability.

1981-2415-2741-2921.easyPrerequisites:
You control another creature.
You have 2 or more life.
1981-2415-2741-2921.description:
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing a creature.
When the creature dies, Havoc Jester triggers, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Essence Warden triggers, causing you to gain life
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Repeat.

1322-3519-7908.easyPrerequisites: The Notary Hobbits' commander tax is 8 or less.
1322-3519-7908.description:
Cast The Notary Hobbits by paying {3}{G}{G} plus commander tax if applicable.
When The Notary Hobbits enters, it triggers, creating two nonlegendary token copies of it.
Activate The Notary Hobbits and the two Notary Hobbits tokens by tapping them, adding {C}{C}{C} for each Halfling you control.
Activate Food Chain by exiling the nontoken Notary Hobbits, adding six {G} that can only be spent to cast creature spells.
Choose to return The Notary Hobbits from exile to the command zone.
Repeat.
1322-3519-7908.notes: It's possible to start with a higher commander tax, but you'll need to control more Halflings and/or have more mana to start.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with three or more +1/+1 counters on it

2122-6260-6822.description:
Activate Mindless Automaton by removing two +1/+1 counters from it, causing you to draw a card.
Lyla triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on Mindless Automaton due to Caradora
Repeat.

206-343-2366-5702.easyPrerequisites:
You have a land card in hand.
You are able to play a land this turn.
206-343-2366-5702.description:
Play a land. When the land enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Dryad Arbor.
When the Dryad Arbor token enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers. Holding priority, activate the Dryad Arbor token by tapping it, adding {G}.
Regal Behemoth triggers, adding {G}.
Resolve the Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Dryad Arbor.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more +1/+1 counters on it

3693-4120-7315.easyPrerequisites: Walking Ballista has a +1/+1 counter on it.
3693-4120-7315.description:
Activate Walking Ballista by removing a +1/+1 counter on it, targeting itself, but putting two +1/+1 counters on it due to Vigor.
Activate Walking Ballista by removing a +1/+1 counter on it, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat.
3693-4120-7315.notes: You may also target your other creatures in step 2 to put +1/+1 counters on them due to Vigor.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to another creature you control

814-3259-6968.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
814-3259-6968.description:
Declare the creature with Breath of Fury attached and Myrel as attackers.
Myrel triggers, creating a creature token.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

1692-2187-2489-3732.easyPrerequisites: Lands you control can tap to produce at least {2}{R}{R}.
1692-2187-2489-3732.notablePrerequisites: You control a creature with power 1 or greater that can attack and that cannot be blocked by an opponent.
1692-2187-2489-3732.description:
Activate any number of lands by tapping them, adding at least {2}{R}{R}.
Cast Relentless Assault by paying {2}{R}{R}, causing you to untap all creatures that attacked this turn and causing you to get an additional combat and main phase after this one.
At the beginning of your combat phase, Helm of the Host triggers, creating a token copy of Possessed Skaab with haste.
When the Possessed Skaab token enters, it triggers, returning Relentless Assault from your graveyard to your hand.
Deal combat damage to an opponent. Nature's Will triggers, untapping all lands you control.
Move to your next main phase and repeat from step 1.

1651-5967-6751-6754-6756.easyPrerequisites: You control a land that enters the battlefield untapped and that can tap to produce at least {1}.
1651-5967-6751-6754-6756.notablePrerequisites: Hearthhull has two or more charge counters on it.
1651-5967-6751-6754-6756.description:
Activate a land by tapping it, adding at least {1}.
Activate Hearthhull by paying {1}, tapping it and sacrificing a land.
If Hearthhull has eight or more charge counters on it, it triggers, causing each opponent to lose 2 life.
Resolve the Hearthhull ability, causing you to draw two cards and allowing you to play an additional land this turn.
Play the land from your graveyard.
When the land enters the battlefield, Eusocial Engineering triggers twice due to Starfield Vocalist, creating two artifact tokens.
Activate Clock of Omens by tapping the artifact tokens, untapping Hearthhull.
Repeat.

2173-5220-5256-6535.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Serrated Scorpion.
When Serrated Scorpion dies, it and Mortuary triggers.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Serrated Scorpion from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Serrated Scorpion trigger, causing you to gain 2 life and dealing 2 damage to each opponent.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Cast Serrated Scorpion from the top of your library by paying 1 life due to Bolas's Citadel.
Repeat.

317-1492-5660.notablePrerequisites: There is at least one additional artifact on the battlefield.
317-1492-5660.description:
Cast Welding Jar by paying {0}.
Activate Welding Jar by sacrificing it.
Mazirek triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Evolution Witness.
Evolution Witness triggers, returning Welding Jar from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Welding Jar ability.
Repeat.

1350-5116-6747.easyPrerequisites: You control at least five artifacts.
1350-5116-6747.description:
Cast Gilded Lotus by paying {0} due to Sami.
Activate Gilded Lotus by tapping it, adding {W}{W}{W}.
Activate Meticulous Excavation by paying {2}{W}, returning Gilded Lotus from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

338-4186-6752.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
338-4186-6752.description:
Gain life.
Light of Promise triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Scurry Oak.
Scurry Oak triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters the battlefield, Haliya triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Repeat from step 2.

1753-3204-4251-6188.notablePrerequisites:
Fear of Missing Out cannot be blocked and killed by an opponent.
Mysterious Limousine does not have summoning sickness and cannot be blocked and killed by an opponent.
One of Fear of Missing Out or Godo must be on the battlefield, with the other exiled by Mysterious Limousine.
1753-3204-4251-6188.description:
Declare either Fear of Missing Out or Godo and Mysterious Limousine as attackers.
Mysterious Limousine and either Fear of Missing Out or Godo trigger.
Resolve the Fear of Missing Out or Godo trigger, untapping Mysterious Limousine and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Resolve the Mysterious Limousine trigger, exiling Fear of Missing Out or Godo from the battlefield, and then returning Fear of Missing Out or Godo from exile to the battlefield.
Repeat each combat phase.

uses.n: Storm the Vault // Vault of Catlacan

304-478-804-1460-2821.notablePrerequisites: You control at least four artifacts.
304-478-804-1460-2821.description:
Animate Candelabra using Tough Cookie
Cast Sakashima the Impostor by paying {2}{U}{U}. Choose to have it enter the battlefield as a copy of Candelabra of Tawnos that is still named Sakashima the Impostor and legendary.
Activate Vault of Catlacan by tapping it, adding at least {U}{U}{U}{U}.
Activate Sakashima the Impostor by paying {2} and tapping it, untapping Minamo and Vault of Catlacan.
Activate Minamo's second ability by paying {U}, untapping Sakashima the Impostor.
Repeat from step 3.

654-5226-5720-5721.notablePrerequisites:
There are at least four card types among cards in your graveyard.
Lands you control and/or land cards in your graveyard that enter the battlefield untapped can tap to produce at least {5}{G}{G}{G}.
654-5226-5720-5721.description:
Activate Lithatog's second ability by sacrificing any land except Shifting Woodland, giving Lithatog +1/+1 until end of turn.
Repeat step 1 until you control no other lands except Shifting Woodland.
Activate Shifting Woodland's second ability by paying {2}{G}{G}, causing it to become a copy of Aftermath Analyst until end of turn.
Activate Shifting Woodland by paying {3}{G} and sacrificing it, returning it and all other land cards from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the lands enter the battlefield, Amulet of Vigor triggers that many times, untapping the lands.
Activate any number of lands by tapping them, adding at least {5}{G}{G}{G}.
Repeat.

779-2146-4970-5751.description:
Cast Chromatic Sphere from your graveyard by paying {0} and discarding Dakmor Salvage.
Activate Chromatic Sphere by paying {1}, tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1} and causing you to mill two cards and return Dakmor Salvage from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

2919-3188-5641.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to put a +1/+1 counter on Basking Broodscale.
2919-3188-5641.description:
Put a +1/+1 counter on Basking Broodscale.
Basking Broodscale triggers, creating a 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature token.
When the Eldrazi Spawn enters the battlefield, Social Climber triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Archangel of Thune triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control.
Repeat from step 2.

1660-3750.notablePrerequisites: Lands and creatures you control can tap to produce at least {3}{R}{R}.
1660-3750.description:
Animate lands you control using Natural Affinity.
Activate all mana producing lands and creatures you control by tapping them, adding at least {3}{R}{R}.
Activate Aggravated Assault by paying {3}{R}{R}, untapping all creatures you control and getting an additional combat and main phase after this phase.
Repeat from step 2.
